_comment: Selection of public RIPE Atlas data used to train the latency forecaster. Owner: Charles. Every ID below was checked against the RIPE Atlas API on 2026-10-29 (see dataset/metadata/ripe_atlas_measurements.json and ripe_atlas_probes.json).

measurements.why: Built-in, ongoing, public IPv4 ping run by every probe every 240 s; anycast target with nearby instances, so RTT reflects the access network quality rather than intercontinental distance.
Second built-in anycast target from the same probes; gives a second independent path per probe.

rejected_candidates.reason: Checked 2026-10-29: user-defined one-off campaign with 1 probe, start 2026-10-28 and stop 2026-10-30 (about 2 days, ~700 readings). Too short for a 20-step forecaster; not used.
The previous downloader labelled built-in IDs as Cloudflare/AWS/Azure pings; those labels were not verified and are not used here.

probe_selection_rule: Public probes in India (country_code=IN) with status 'Connected' on 2026-10-29, an IPv4 ASN, and the highest total_uptime; access-network = residential/ISP ASNs, datacentre = probes hosted in cloud/hosting networks (AWS AS16509, Oracle AS31898, DigitalOcean AS14061, E2E AS132420, OVH AS16276). India was chosen because the project team and target hospitals are in India.
